intro: Three regular-sized dates have about 70 kcal. Almost all of it is concentrated natural sugar, because dates are a dried fruit.

variants.name: Air kurma susu / date milk (1 glass)

diet: Yes. Three dates make a small snack that gives quick energy, for example before a workout or when breaking fast. The catch is that dates are easy to overeat without noticing. Count them, and don't eat straight from the container.
tips: Take 3 dates, put them on a small plate, and close the container.
Eat 2-3 dates 30-60 minutes before exercise for energy.
Pair them with a glass of low-fat milk or an egg for extra protein.

swap.name: Regular-sized dates (not big medjool)
swap.why: Small dates have about one-third the calories of large medjool dates for the same number of pieces.

faq.q: How many dates should I eat a day?
faq.a: For most people, 3 a day is enough as a snack. If you eat more, count them in your daily calories.

faq.q: Are dates good for breaking fast?
faq.a: Yes, dates give quick energy after a full day of fasting. Follow up with plain water and some protein.

faq.q: Are dates good for pregnant mums?
faq.a: Many mums eat dates, especially in the last trimester. For specific advice, ask your doctor.
